decisions.reason: The pictures are supporting evidence for reviewing the completed changes; the source does not change the accepted documentation methods or require the pictures to be included in the concurrence deliverable.
Providing pictures as review evidence does not alter the requirement to apply a PE stamp and signature.
The source concerns confirmation of completed changes for the North Las Vegas as-built review, not the separate additional permit-drawing project.
The source concerns photographic evidence for the as-built modification review and does not change calculation obligations for the separate additional permit project.
